verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a public API with a full HTTP and SDK reference, including a v2 Posts resource, a Reports API, and a Training Data API. It also offers an agent-oriented find/replace endpoint for help-center articles and publishes llms.txt for AI consumption. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at the standard paths, no independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, and thin evidence on authentication and coverage across the whole product.
